whoItsFor: Developers who live in the terminal and want a free, lightweight way to use Gemini for coding, codebase Q&A, scripting, and workflow automation. Also suited to teams that want Gemini inside GitHub workflows or MCP-based tooling.
useCases: Query, edit, and debug large codebases with natural language
Generate new apps from PDFs, images, or sketches and automate ops tasks like PR queries or rebases
Run non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation
